description: Arabic-script discovery covered general Oman-month protest terms; Oman Observer, Times of Oman, Muscat Daily, Al Shabiba, Al Roya, Al Watan and Oman News Agency; regional terms for Muscat, Sohar and Salalah; and worker-sector terms. Results were often dominated by May 2021 protests, old protest history, administrative labour reports or COVID notices. A generic عمان query also returned Jordan coverage, requiring the country-specific سلطنة عمان wording. No complete Arabic newspaper/archive review or fluent local review was performed.
required_followup: A fluent reviewer should search January 2021 local archives and social-sector reporting directly, using protest/march/sit-in/strike variants and country/place spellings in Arabic. Do not treat the current search as exhaustive.

Al Shabiba pages S039, S041 and S043 also returned web-open cache misses; one normal HTTPS attempt to S039 failed DNS before any HTTP response. No site-level denial was observed.

The canonical Oman Observer labor report S029 and the Ministry of Interior notice S013 were opened; do not treat inaccessible variants as independent sources. One ordinary request to the affected Shabiba URL also failed before reaching a server; retry only if normal network access becomes available.
